answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 37549 Country: United Kingdom Title: I am writing from UK where many Asian people work in restaurant. I am a tandoor chef and I am not making or serving any types of alcohol. But restaurant owners sell alcohol by different stuff. Is it permissible for me to do job at such type of restaurant? And is it permissible to send message to non-mahram like a cousin or niece? Question: c. But restaurant owners sell alcohol by different stuff. Is it permissible for me to do job at such type of restaurant? And is it permissible to send message to non-mahram like a cousin or niece? Answer ID: 37549 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 31/19/N=1433) (1) When you do not do any job related to alcohol and you are only baker in the restaurant then yours employment is lawful and the income earned from it is lawful. But if you are getting an employment in a restaurant where there is no use and sale of alcohol in any form, then it is better that you prefer it. (2) It is unlawful to send unlawful message. You can send any important message or religious one but it is better that it is also avoided and in cases of need it should be done through some mahram. (Bahishti Zewar 11:141) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
